title: Preserve a retained-session open when the child becomes resident during its tail read
outcome: An explicit open click opens the requested child in the target pane even if a valid concurrent resume or another pane made the session resident during the bounded read; cancellation and identity guards still hold.
acceptance: A deterministic test starts a retained-child tail read, admits the child through sessionCreated before the response, and verifies the original target pane opens the resident session.
A deterministic test opens the child concurrently in another pane and verifies the original pending click also opens its requested pane without a duplicate transcript read.
Closed panes, superseded requests and server identity changes still cancel safely.
